designFeasibility.scope: Normal one-tick x/A/B input samples with8neutral ticks per press, all crane intervals, ballast and roll. Not production input-cancellation, UI or browser evidence.
designFeasibility.interfaceAcceptanceScope: Root read the full isolated design checker source and its two canonical-arithmetic line corrections before the first unique execution, then the actual public feasibility report. Root read the public rules and complete interface, reviewed the final assembled contract additions and confirmed unchanged physical/level data. No private witness was read. This accepts the implementation contract, not production or browser validation.
designFeasibility.formalScope: Thirty synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

ordinaryRounds.scope: Exactly the intended three ordinary wins and three public-policy natural losses; stop on first failure. The raw corpus is retained compactly with complete actual interval evidence. Independent review consumes a lossless public projection without pilotDiagnostics. No duplicate strategy or cadence matrix.

independentReview.method: Existing actual observations only. Immutable job receipts define an absolute stage/transfer calendar; integer target spans determine ballast. Ownership mass/moment is recomputed from IDs. A 4-by-4 augmented matrix raised by repeated squaring integrates each constant-cargo and constant-ballast-direction span from the independent prior endpoint; observed angles never reset that origin. Each actual post-angle gate is checked strictly, and every matrix-derived gate must agree without tolerance.
limitations: This is an audit of these six existing ordinary rounds, not a new game run or proof for every possible input/layout.

Input samples, command legality, action priority, receipt links and reported eligible navigation ages are checked. Full button rearming, navigation repeat timing and cancellation state machines are not independently replayed.
API invalid-dt, terminal/pause freeze, retry and synthetic simultaneous-failure boundaries are outside this ordinary-corpus audit; absent branches are not claimed covered.

The roll matrix is mathematically equivalent to the public fixed-step recurrence but groups floating arithmetic differently. The 1e-8 absolute allowance applies only to derived numeric values; every observed safety/departure gate remains strict and is separately compared with the independent prediction.

The physical model has fixed GM/roll radius and shore-supported cargo; this report makes no real-vessel engineering claim. No Model, pilot, author solver, private witness or new gameplay was read or executed.

numericalComparison.gateMargins: Per-round observed and predicted distances from all four angular thresholds, with measured matrix-vs-observation error envelopes; no gate is widened.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Actual browser commands, cargo inventory and permanent histories. Live images retain two real endpoints; no single pixel-state identity or new roll solver is asserted.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual cargo ownership, permanent receipts and recorded results. Dynamic roll and stage arithmetic are covered by the independent public-observation audit; no physics replay or scheduler runs in this adapter.

modelTests.scope: Thirty synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryHarborManagement.scope: Actual key edges, sampled cargo identities and detached permanent input/transfer/job receipts. Sparse samples do not observe every roll interval or last-operation update; gaps remain explicit. No roll integration or crane-state replay is run here. Menu pilot preparations are excluded from gameplay evidence.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Actual post-dispatch snapshots and the next decision tick, or an observed later terminal tick. Recipe/menu observations remain separately identified.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Existing periodic observations and a terminal hold select these personally reviewed encoded images. Receipt timing is not an exact pixel-state identity; no new capture or full decode is performed.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
